chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from 'Anbasah al-'Abid, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"And He is the One who made the night and the day to succeed one another for one who desires to take heed or desires gratitude."
He عليه السلام said: "Making up the night prayer in the day, and making up the day prayer in the night."

key_terms.خِلْفَةً: succession or alternation, meaning one follows the other
key_terms.شُكُورًا: gratitude or thankfulness shown through worship
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: making up an act of worship after its time

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام interpret the verse about night and day succeeding one another?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains this verse as referring to the alternation of night and day as an opportunity to make up missed prayers. What is missed in the night may be performed in the day, and what is missed in the day may be performed in the night. The verse thus highlights divine facilitation in worship and remembrance.
